gloss: Nagano (prefecture and city in central Honshu)

definitions.gloss: Nagano (prefecture and city in central Honshu)
definitions.explanation: A mountainous, landlocked prefecture in central Honshu and its capital city. Host of the 1998 Winter Olympics and home of the temple Zenkōji.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The old province was {信濃|しなの}, and the area is still often called {信州|しんしゅう}, as in {信州|しんしゅう}そば (buckwheat noodles) and {信州|しんしゅう}みそ. Much of the Japanese Alps lies in the prefecture, which makes it a center for skiing and mountain resorts such as ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧.
